en.onboarding_1_desc: Scan your physical vessel to detect underlying spiritual micro-vibrations and soul resonance.
en.onboarding_2_desc: Discover how your current incarnation's trajectory aligns with your soul's source frequency.
en.onboarding_3_desc: Glimpse into the field of your future timelines, karmic lessons, and spiritual evolution.
en.permission_desc: Grant access to the camera to capture your unique energy signature. Your data is purely for this session.
en.input_age_hint: Number of years you have spent in this body.
en.input_focus_hint: Which area of your life do you want the AI to analyze and predict?
en.input_mood_hint: How do you feel right now? (e.g. peaceful, stressed, ready for change, happy).
en.input_goal_hint: What is the ONE thing you want to attract or achieve in the next year?
en.aura_blue_desc: Your aura radiates at a high frequency of intuition and truth. You are currently in a phase of deep internal reflection, where your third eye is opening to new dimensions of reality. Use this energy for meditation and channeling.
en.aura_green_desc: Your vibrational field is vibrating with the frequency of healing and balance. You are attracting prosperity through heart-centered actions. This is a time of immense growth and emotional renewal.
en.aura_red_desc: Your energy is focused on the Root Chakra. You are manifesting physical reality with great power right now. Strive for balance between your spiritual aspirations and your earthly needs.
en.path_current_desc: If you maintain your current frequency, you will experience steady growth, but may encounter familiar karmic loops. Observe your patterns to transcend them.
en.path_optimized_desc: By aligning your intention with your soul mission, you unlock an accelerated timeline of abundance and spiritual clarity within the next 3 cycles.
en.path_risk_desc: Avoid stagnation by releasing old energetic attachments. Without conscious alignment, you might face temporary blocks in your manifestation flow.
en.future_self_desc: This is your Light Body in its next phase. You are moving toward an state of higher consciousness and material abundance.
en.sharing_text: My future soul prediction shocked me

sl.onboarding_1_desc: Skeniraj svoje zemeljsko telo za zaznavanje skritih duhovnih mikro-vibracij in resonance duše.
sl.onboarding_2_desc: Odkrij, kako se pot tvoje trenutne inkarnacije ujema z izvornostjo tvoje duše.
sl.onboarding_3_desc: Zaviri v polje tvojih prihodnjih časovnic, karmičnih lekcij in duhovne evolucije.
sl.permission_desc: Dovoli dostop do kamere, da zajamemo tvoj unikatni energijski podpis. Podatki so namenjeni le tej seansi.
sl.input_age_hint: Koliko let si v tem fizičnem telesu?
sl.input_focus_hint: Katero področje življenja želiš, da AI analizira in napove?
sl.input_mood_hint: Opiši svojo notranjo energijo v tem trenutku (npr. 'miren/a', 'pod stresom', 'pripravljen/a na spremembo').
sl.input_goal_hint: Kaj je tista ENA stvar, ki jo želiš manifestirati v naslednjem letu?
sl.aura_blue_desc: Tvoja aura vibrira na visoki frekvenci intuije in resnice. Trenutno si v fazi globoke notranje refleksije, kjer se tvoje tretje oko odpira novim razsežnostim realnosti. Uporabi to energijo za meditacijo in kanaliziranje.
sl.aura_green_desc: Tvoje vibracijsko polje utripa s frekvenco zdravljenja in ravnovesja. S srčno naravnanimi dejanji privabljaš blaginjo. To je čas izjemne rasti in čustvene prenove.
sl.aura_red_desc: Tvoja energija je usmerjena v korensko čakro. Trenutno z veliko močjo manifestiraš fizično realnost. Prizadevaj si za ravnovesje med svojimi duhovnimi prizadevanji in zemeljskimi potrebami.
sl.path_current_desc: Če ohraniš trenutno frekvenco, boš doživel/a stabilno rast, a se lahko srečaš s ponavljajočimi se karmičnimi zankami. Opazuj svoje vzorce za napredek.
sl.path_optimized_desc: Z uskladitvijo tvojega namena z dušnim poslanstvom odkleneš pospešeno časovnico obilja in duhovne jasnosti v naslednjih 3 ciklih.
sl.path_risk_desc: Izogni se stagnaciji s sproščanjem starih energetskih navezav. Brez zavestne poravnave se lahko soočiš z začasnimi blokadami v pretoku manifestacije.
sl.future_self_desc: To je tvoje svetlobno telo v naslednji fazi. Pomikaš se proti stanju višje zavesti in materialnega obilja.
sl.sharing_text: Moja napoved duše me je presunila
